headline: Ecovyst Beats Q3 Earnings Estimates and Raises Full-Year Outlook
summary: Ecovyst reported third-quarter earnings that beat estimates by US$0.02 and raised its full-year financial outlook.
why: Ecovyst is a specialized chemical company. Earnings beats and guidance upgrades are primary drivers of valuation for mid-cap industrial stocks.

impacts.name: Ecovyst
impacts.why: The company beat earnings estimates and raised its outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Positive earnings surprises and guidance upgrades typically lead to upward revisions in analyst models and stock price appreciation.
